Place the extracted Bootstrap distribution here:
  static/vendor/bootstrap/css/bootstrap.min.css
  static/vendor/bootstrap/css/bootstrap.min.css.map
  static/vendor/bootstrap/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js
  static/vendor/bootstrap/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js.map

Use bootstrap.bundle.min.js (includes Popper) rather than the plain bootstrap.min.js.
